result.title: PatentAgentBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents with Professional Patent Task Suites
result.summary: Patent practice lies at the intersection of technical, legal, and linguistic work, making it challenging yet crucial to technological innovation. Recently, rapid advances in large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems have demonstrated the potential to complete realistic business workflows and even patent works. This raises a question: can current AI systems perform patent work reliably? Existing benchmarks cover a limited range of patent tasks and simplify evidence acquisition by providing reference materials or candidate documents. In this paper, we introduce PatentAgentBench, a benchmark comprising 510 instances across eight task suites: novelty search, freedom-to-operate (FTO) search, design FTO, invalidity search, claim charting, patent drafting, office-action response, and patent translation. Curated from real patent records and professional materials, the benchmark combines task-specific metrics with expert-reviewed annotations and rubrics. Retrieval tasks such novelty search, FTO, etc., require agents to search and compare patent collections without a supplied candidate pool. The drafting and OAR tasks assess the quality of agents' work given technical disclosure and office action notice. We evaluate seven LLMs across four agent harnesses on PatentAgentBench, finding that current systems still struggle to identify novelty, assess risk, and understand practitioner intent throughout patent workflows.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 PatentAgentBench：从真实专利记录与专业材料整理出 510 个实例、覆盖新颖性检索、FTO、无效检索、权利要求对照、撰写与审查意见答复等八类任务的基准，并在四种 agent harness 下评测七个 LLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 其检索类任务不提供候选文档池，要求 agent 自主查找证据并判断新颖性与风险，可能为 LVR 中「获取证据、何时停止检索」的评价设计提供参照；但与视觉或多模态推理无直接关联，联系较远，可供核查。
